description: For over six decades, humanity has launched its greatest technological achievements into the void—leaving behind landers, rovers, cameras, and commemorative artifacts across extraterrestrial soils.
summary: Every mission ends one day. Some robots ran out of fuel, some lost power in dust storms, and some are still drifting through space. We wanted children to feel that these machines were not just hardware, but explorers that taught us something. Abandoned, but never forgotten.
details:
🤖 Abandoned but Not Forgotten — a kid-friendly web game about NASA's retired robots and machines.

Hidden in the dark of space are rovers, landers, telescopes and satellites that NASA left behind. In this game you explore a floating space map, find each machine, hear its story in its own "robot voice", and earn a badge by answering quiz questions.

🚀 What you can do in the game

• Explore a draggable, zoomable space field with 38 hidden NASA missions

• Tap each object to read (or listen to) its story and see real NASA photos

• Learn fun facts about Spirit, Opportunity, Skylab, Ingenuity, Cassini, Kepler and many more

• Play the Robot Quiz: 10 questions, 2 chances each, with hints

• Collect badges and beat your high score
